title: Where to shop for new born stuff
label: gear

posts.body:
Hi, 

We are expecting our first child and have just moved to hong kong. Can any members share some tips on where best to purchase reasonably priced items in readiness of the arrival of a new born (e.g. Cots, diapers, breast pumps etc)? I have read much earlier threads on b2b, mother care and Eugene club. Are those places still recommended or are there others? 

Thanks in advance for your replies.

Here's a list of Baby shops around HK

Shops With Baby Products - Hong Kong GeoBaby

Ah Ci Co is a small little store next to Tsan Yuk and has everything at reasonable prices.

posts.body: @ kheing those are the major stores that most people go to. There are also Tiny Footprints in Central and Babies'R'Us (several locations, often inside Toys'R'Us but there is a standalone store in TST). Many of the the malls like Windsor House and Cyberport have a number of baby stores too.
